title: Electric force magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The final numerical answer for the electric force must be correct, approximately 6.0 × 10⁻³ N.

title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The final numerical answer for the electric field strength must be correct, approximately 0.6 N/C.

title: Force balance diagram
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly identify the three forces (gravity, tension, electric) and set up a free-body diagram or equivalent force balance.

title: Trigonometric force resolution
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly resolve forces to relate the electric force to gravity using the tangent of the given angle (Fe = mg tan 37°).

title: Electric field direction
description: Important Criteria: The solution must state the direction of the electric field as horizontal and to the left, consistent with the negative charge and equilibrium position.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The solution should correctly handle units (Newtons, Coulombs) throughout the calculation.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize stating the electric field direction as right, or incorrectly using sine/cosine instead of tangent in the force balance.

title: Formula misapplication
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize using E = F/q before finding Fe, or incorrectly calculating tan 37°.
